brief_en: Quiet window across frontier labs. No major official model releases, product launches, research papers, or executive announcements from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Meta AI, xAI or tracked open-source players in the last 12 hours. Monitoring continues on existing product updates.
